title: The Clockmaker's Book Cipher
description:
🗝️ Recovered Notebook Page listing numerical references: '1-1-1 2-1-2'.
Page excerpt:
Line 1: BEWARE ALL TRAITORS
Line 2: THE COUSIN FLEES
question: Translate the code 1-1-1 (Line 1, Word 1) 2-1-2 (Line 2, Word 2) to identify the target warning.
hints: Book ciphers use pairs or triplets: Line Number - Word Number.
solution: Lookup 1-1-1 gives 'BEWARE' and 2-1-2 gives 'COUSIN'. Combined answer: BEWARE COUSIN.
